verdict.rationale: Expensify publishes Integration Server API documentation covering credential generation (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret), secret rotation, and an OAuth2 authorization code flow for acting on behalf of individual users. That is a documented public API a programmatic or AI-native user can authenticate against. missing for 10: evidence of which operations the API exposes (e.g. creating expenses, managing reports and workspaces), endpoint/reference depth, a machine-friendly docs format (the .md docs probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of using the API.
